mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username AS author_username FROM bbs_comment c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_comment_id, c.id), c.id
SELECT c.*, u.username AS author_username FROM bbs_comment c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_comment (post_id, parent_comment_id, author_id, anonymous_name, anonymous_pwd_hash, content, ip_address, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{authorId}, #{anonymousName}, #{anonymousPwdHash}, #{content}, #{ipAddress, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs_comment SET content = #{content}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bbs_comment SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
